purpose: Dedicated staff team, objectives and help icons

prompts.team: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original professional raster game toolbar icon for TEAM management in cozy hotel tycoon Hotel Empire. Subject: a compact paired bust icon of two friendly hotel employees, heads side by side at equal height, shoulders slightly overlapping in a single cohesive silhouette. Male receptionist on left with tan skin, short swept dark brown hair, warm ivory shirt, navy vest and simple brass button; female housekeeper on right with tan skin, dark brown hair in a low bun, dusty rose blouse, broad ivory apron. Simple large friendly facial shapes, faces readable as a pair, little uniform detail. Refined hand-painted game art with soft modeled materials, warm upper-left lighting, cozy ivory/brass/navy/rose palette. Square composition; whole pair including heads and shoulders centered within middle 80 percent of canvas with fully transparent padding on all edges. True transparent RGBA background. No text, letters, numbers, badges with writing, tools, logo, watermark, frame, scene, external cast shadow or ground. Not SVG, vector, flat clipart, pixel art or photograph. Strong clear silhouette for 28px toolbar icon, not detailed portrait proportions. ONE icon only.

prompts.help: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original professional raster game toolbar icon for HELP GUIDE in cozy hotel tycoon Hotel Empire. Refined hand-painted game art with soft dimensional modeling, warm upper-left light, original cozy ivory/jade/brass palette. Square canvas, whole open book and question mark centered within middle 80 percent and fully transparent padding every edge. True transparent RGBA background. No words, letters, numbers, writing, page lines, logo, watermark, stars, hearts, people, scene, UI frame, ground, external cast shadow, particles or glitter. Not SVG, vector, flat clipart, pixel art or photograph. Clearly recognizable at 28px. ONE icon only.

team_refinement.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this team icon into a compact professional GAME TOOLBAR ICON while preserving the receptionist and housekeeper identities, navy/ivory and rose/ivory uniforms, friendly faces and original painted materials. Recompose the two busts as a small balanced cohesive pair with similar head sizes; show only their upper chest and rounded shoulders, no long torsos. Make their heads nearly level, with slightly overlapping shoulders. MOST IMPORTANT: the whole paired silhouette must fit comfortably within the central 76% of the square canvas, fully clear and clean 12% transparent padding on EVERY edge. Remove any detached edge speckles. Keep silhouettes complete, never crop hair or shoulders. Bold shapes for 28px readability, less fine detail. True transparent RGBA background, preserve transparency. ONE paired icon only, no text, frame, logo, scene, floor or external cast shadow.
